extraction.Name: Mollie Gaughen
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to V. J. Haiglas for $1000; conveyed by deed to Frank Sully for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612771 issued; Northeast quarter section 5, township 98, range 74; receipt signed by allottee February 11, 1918; in 1913 a Lis pendens was filed against the land probably owing to the suit filed by the Sullys against the United States in order to obtain their allotments; Mollie Gaughen is a relative of the Sullys; mortgage to V. J. Haiglas on May 22, 1918; conveyance to Frank Sully dated June 14, 1919; patent recorded by Emmet Gaughen on June 25, 1918; document dated June 1929
